Excuse me, it is because ".... we don't draw our FL until it hits target..."

The difference is that engulf of green box (your red circle) happened before price hit TG above - red box. So we don't draw boxes until the TG is hit. In this case TG after breaking middle red box is red box above - once it is hit we can draw FL below (blue box). In this way when it is engulfed at B, price is coming from a valid TG, and we have high quality PA signal.

EDIT: I just saw your edit after posting this, yes you got it right

Whenever wrote:...I thought I got it too... but what about here instead? We draw the Red Box before it hits the lower target?

That's the whole point that IF is trying to illustrate here. You can't draw in the UFL in that example because price didn't yet hit the target. This could simply be a flag that is expanding. I guess it's a common mistake that people tend to make, so it's most clear to illustrate it like this.:)

When we draw the FL after a break we draw from high to low. If the high gets broken like in 2nd image we exclude the low that broke out after previous high was broke.

1st image has a double top so fails to break the high. Hence we draw to lowest low.

That's my attempt at answering
